why: Dental clinics need treatment plans, staged payments (deposit + installments) and a tooth chart, distinct from general clinic appointments.
operator: The dentist sees patients across shifts. Their day is treatment plans, staged payments, tooth charting and follow-up reminders. Each treatment has a cost, a deposit and a schedule for the remaining installments.
entities: DentalClinic (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
Patient (id, clinicId, name, phone, encryptedHealthData, consentWhatsApp, guardianPhone, visitsCount)
TreatmentPlan (id, patientId, nameAr, nameEn, surfaces, chartNumber, depositPiasters, totalPiasters, installmentCount, status, notes)
ToothChart (id, patientId, chart with tooth numbers, surfaces marked, treatment notes per tooth)
Installment (id, treatmentPlanId, amountPiasters, dueDate, status, paidAt)
Appointment (id, clinicId, patientId, dateTime, duration, type, status, notes)
batches: No : dental clinic carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Treatment plans are not product-based
special: The core structures are the treatment plan with staged payments, the tooth chart per patient, the installment tracker and the appointment system. Patient data is special-category: encrypted, exportable on request, deletable on request.
screens: Appointment calendar: day/week view with patient names, status colours
Patient record: name, phone, guardian, visit history, consent flag, encrypted health summary
Treatment plan editor: add plan, select tooth chart, set deposit and total, choose installment count
Tooth chart: interactive chart with tooth numbers, mark surfaces treated, add notes per tooth
Installment tracker: list of installments per treatment, amounts due, paid status, receipt print
Payment screen: accept deposit or installment, record payment, print receipt
Shift summary: patient load, treatments completed, outstanding installments
roles: Owner: everything : treatment plans, staff, reports, billing
Dentist: create treatment plans, edit tooth chart, approve installments
Dental assistant: enter treatment plans, chart teeth, mark installments paid
Cashier: accept payments, print receipts, shift close
reports: Treatment plan volume per dentist per period
Installment collection rate: collected vs outstanding, aging report
Tooth chart completion: which plans have full charting vs partial
Patient treatment history: all plans per patient, completion rate
Shift summary: hours worked, treatments completed, outstanding deposits
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for payment receipts and treatment plans
WhatsApp deep link for appointment reminders and follow-up prompts
Google Calendar sync for appointment reminders
onboarding: Clinic basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Specialities: the dental services offered (cleaning, filling, root canal, ortho, etc.)
Treatment plan types: the plan templates the clinic uses (single treatment, multi-tooth, full mouth)
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: set up first treatment plan template, first patient, first payment flow
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the treatment plan/installment/tooth chart schema and role templates.

tasks.title: Add treatment plan editor with tooth chart
tasks.brief: Build the UI for creating a treatment plan: select tooth chart, set deposit and total price, choose installment count. Done when the plan saves to Firestore and the tooth chart is selectable.
tasks.done: When treatment plan editor works and saves plan with tooth chart

tasks.title: Add installment tracker per treatment plan
tasks.brief: Build the installment screen: list of installments, amounts due, paid status, receipt print. Done when each installment is recorded and the total matches the plan.
tasks.done: When installment tracker records payments and computes outstanding correctly

tasks.title: Add interactive tooth chart
tasks.brief: Build the tooth chart UI: tooth numbers, mark surfaces treated, add notes per tooth. Done when the chart saves and displays correctly per patient.
tasks.done: When tooth chart saves patient data and displays correctly

tasks.title: Add payment screen for deposits and installments
tasks.brief: Build the payment screen: accept deposit or installment payment, record payment, print receipt. Done when payment saves to the installment doc and receipt prints correctly.
tasks.done: When payment screen works end-to-end and receipt prints

tasks.title: Add WhatsApp deep link for appointment reminder
tasks.brief: Build the WhatsApp deep link that sends an appointment reminder to the patient. Done when the link opens WhatsApp with pre-filled appointment details.
tasks.done: When WhatsApp link opens chat with pre-filled appointment info

tasks.title: Add treatment plan completion report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing treatment plans by completion status. Done when the report pulls live data and displays completion rates per dentist.
tasks.done: When treatment completion report pulls live data and displays correctly

tasks.title: Add outstanding installments aging report
tasks.brief: Build the aging report: installments by due date, how many overdue, total outstanding. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct aging buckets.
tasks.done: When aging report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add patient treatment history screen
tasks.brief: Build the screen showing all treatment plans per patient, their status and completion. Done when the screen pulls and displays patient's full treatment history.
tasks.done: When patient treatment history screen works and displays correctly

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial dental setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: clinic basics, dental specialities, treatment plan templates, staff addition. Done when the flow completes and the clinic appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and clinic is created

tasks.title: Add payment summary report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing total payments collected per period, per dentist, outstanding per patient. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When payment summary report computes correctly from live data

risks: Patient health data is special-category: mishandling violates PDPL
Encryption key loss makes patient records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Staged payments can create disputes if installment terms are unclear
